tweets: Due to missing access controls, malicious parties can withdraw some or all Ether from a contract account.
This bug is sometimes caused by unintentionally exposing initialization functions.
Wrongly naming a function as a constructor places its code in runtime bytecode.
Anyone can then call that exposed constructor to re-initialize the contract.
